summary: Titan Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with OpenPayd Global Holdings Limited (PubCo), OpenPayd Holdings Limited (target), and related parties. The amendment clarifies that parties will use reasonable best efforts to redeem all outstanding purchaser warrants prior to or concurrent with acquisition closing. No financial terms (price, premium, implied value) disclosed. The SPAC targets a fintech/fintech infrastructure company. Watch for shareholder vote timing, redemption trends, and regulatory approvals to gauge deal completion risk.
